messages.author: 931d8e44b7f28eb6
messages.subject: Shiny App deployment error
parts:
I am having issues deploying my shiny app. When I try and deploy it from rStudio, I get the following:

Preparing to deploy application...DONE
Uploading bundle for application: 95194...DONE
Deploying bundle: 422514 for application: 95194 ...
Waiting for task: 180266807
  building: Building package: digest
################################ Begin Task Log ################################ 
################################# End Task Log ################################# 
Error: Unhandled Exception: Child Task 180266808 error: Unhandled Exception: HTTP 599: Connection closed

The app shows up on my shinyapps.io dashboard as undeployed.

It looks like others have had this issue, but it was an issue that was previously fixed. I'm just learning shiny and this is my first app, so it is pretty simple and has no real dependencies.
